## UPSET PLOTS & HEATMAP (P<0.0001) 
#### DEOMGRAPHIC MODEL (FIGURE 4)
```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

### Demographic EWAS 
### P<0.0001 level
overlap_demo <- list("Grew up in a rural area" = demographic_rural$CpG[demographic_rural$P.Value < 0.0001],
        "Years in school" = demographic_schlyrs$CpG[demographic_schlyrs$P.Value < 0.0001],
        "Live with a grandparent" = demographic_livegpar$CpG[demographic_livegpar$P.Value < 0.0001],
        "Smoking during childhood" = demographic_chsmk$CpG[demographic_chsmk$P.Value < 0.0001])
names(overlap_demo)


### Create UpSet plot
png(here::here("Manuscript/Revisions/Compare_Models/Sept262026upsetplot_demographic_plessthan0.0001.png"), width=7, height=5, units='in', res=300)

upset(fromList(overlap_demo), nsets=4)

dev.off()


#### overlapping nominal sites (1 site between grew up in a rural area & years in school & child smoking)
counts_demo <- table(unlist(overlap_demo))
overlap_demo_1 <- names(counts_demo)[counts_demo == 3]
overlap_demo_1
######*ALL MAP TO ITGAL

#### overlapping nominal sites (8 sites between grew up in a rural area & years in school)
overlap_demo_8 <- setdiff(intersect(overlap_demo[["Grew up in a rural area"]], overlap_demo[["Years in school"]]), overlap_demo_1)
overlap_demo_8

```

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

listp <- all_exposures %>% dplyr::filter(P.Value < 0.0001) %>% 
                              dplyr::group_by(exposure) %>% 
                              dplyr::summarise(CpGs = list(unique(CpG)), .groups = "drop") %>% tibble::deframe()

              sets = names(listp),
              nsets = 4,
              order.by = "freq")

dev.off()
```


#### HEATMAP OF EFFECT ESTIMATES FOR NOMINAL SITES (P<1x10-4) (FIGURE 4)
#####DEMOGRAPHIC
```{r}

#Merge into one list for plotting
list_corr <- list("Growing up in a rural area" = demographic_rural, 
                  "Years in school" = demographic_schlyrs, 
                  "Living with a grandparent" = demographic_livegpar, 
                  "Smoking during childhood" = demographic_chsmk)

#Set an identifier column
merge_corr <- bind_rows(list_corr, .id = "Exposure") %>% 
              filter(P.Value < 0.0001) 

exp_order <- c("Grew up in a rural area", "Smoking during childhood", "Live with a grandparent", "Years in school")

#Using demographic model: 5,959 (71 = rural, 5363 = school, 18 = grandparent, 507 = smoking)


#Use pheatmap
#create matrix
merge_corrph <- merge_corr %>% select(CpG, Exposure, logFCpercent) %>%
              pivot_wider(names_from = Exposure, values_from = logFCpercent, values_fill = 0) %>%
              tibble::column_to_rownames("CpG") %>%
              as.matrix()


#Set boundaries for color gradient
minph <- min(merge_corrph)
maxph <- max(merge_corrph)
#breakmax <- seq(minph, maxph, length.out = 51)
breakmax <- c(seq(minph, -1, length.out = 3), seq(-0.8, 0.8, length.out = 45), seq(1, maxph, length.out=3))

setHook("grid.newpage", function() pushViewport(viewport(x = 0.93, y = 0.5, width = 0.85, height = 0.85, name = "vp", just = c("right"))), action = "prepend")
## Create plot
pheatmap(merge_corrph, border_color = "black", 
         show_rownames = FALSE, 
         #cutree_cols = 4,
         gaps_col = c(1, 2, 3),
         cluster_rows = TRUE,
         #treeheight_row = 0,
         cluster_cols = FALSE,
         angle_col = "45",
         color = colorRampPalette(c("darkblue", "#b3b3ff", "white", "#ff0000", "darkred"))(50),
         breaks = breakmax,
         fontsize_col = 18)
setHook("grid.newpage", NULL, "replace")
grid.text("CpG", x = -0.07, gp = gpar(fontsize = 18))

```

## SCATTER PLOTS (Supplemental Figure 9)

### COMPARE MODEL COEFFICENTS BETWEEN EXPOSURES (Demographic)

```{r, warning=FALSE}

png("Manuscript/Revisions/Compare_Models/Oct122026exposure-by-exposure-betas-scatter_allp.png", width=2800, height=1750, res = 300)

par(mfrow=c(2, 3), mar=c(5,5,2,2))

#rural x schlyrs
both.results <- demographic_rural %>%
  inner_join(demographic_schlyrs, by="CpG", suffix=c(".demographic_rural", ".demographic_schlyrs")) %>%
  select(CpG, beta.demographic_rural = logFC.demographic_rural, p.demographic_rural = P.Value.demographic_rural, 
         beta.demographic_schlyrs = logFC.demographic_schlyrs, p.demographic_schlyrs = P.Value.demographic_schlyrs)
# All CpGs
smoothScatter(both.results$beta.demographic_rural ~ both.results$beta.demographic_schlyrs, 
              xlab="Years in school", ylab="Grew up in a rural area", cex.lab=1.8, cex.axis=1.1)
cor_r <- cor(both.results$beta.demographic_rural, both.results$beta.demographic_schlyrs)
mtext(paste("r = ", round(cor_r, 2)), side=3, line=-1.8, adj=0.05, cex=1.3)


#rural x livegpar
both.results <- demographic_rural %>%
  inner_join(demographic_livegpar, by="CpG", suffix=c(".demographic_rural", ".demographic_livegpar")) %>%

              xlab="Live with a grandparent", ylab="Grew up in a rural area", cex.lab=1.8, cex.axis=1.1)
cor_r <- cor(both.results$beta.demographic_rural, both.results$beta.demographic_livegpar)
```

## COMPARE SITES WITHIN OUR STUDY

```{r, warning=FALSE}

#CHILD RURAL OVERLAP
overlap_rural <- Reduce(intersect, list(rural_m3$CpG, demographic_rural$CpG, h_rural$CpG))

overlap_rural <- data.frame(
  CpG = overlap_rural,
  chr = rural_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_rural) %>% pull(CHR),
  pos = rural_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_rural) %>% pull(BP),
  gene = rural_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_rural) %>% pull(UCSC_RefGene_Name),
  rural_m3.estimate = rural_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_rural) %>% pull(logFC),
  rural_m3.pval = rural_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_rural) %>% pull(P.Value),
  demographic_rural.estimate = demographic_rural %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_rural) %>% pull(logFC),
  demographic_rural.pval = demographic_rural %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_rural) %>% pull(P.Value),
  h_rural.estimate = h_rural %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_rural) %>% pull(logFC),
  h_rural.pval = h_rural %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_rural) %>% pull(P.Value)
)

overlap_rural$gene <- gsub(";.*", "", overlap_rural$gene)
write_xlsx(overlap_rural, "Manuscript/Revisions/Compare_Models/ALL Child Rural Models CpG Overlap.xlsx", format_headers = TRUE)


#SCHLYRS OVERLAP
overlap_schlyrs <- Reduce(intersect, list(schlyrs_m3$CpG, demographic_schlyrs$CpG, h_schlyrs$CpG))

overlap_schlyrs <- data.frame(
  CpG = overlap_schlyrs,
  chr = schlyrs_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_schlyrs) %>% pull(CHR),
  pos = schlyrs_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_schlyrs) %>% pull(BP),
  gene = schlyrs_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_schlyrs) %>% pull(UCSC_RefGene_Name),
  schlyrs_m3.estimate = schlyrs_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_schlyrs) %>% pull(logFC),
  schlyrs_m3.pval = schlyrs_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_schlyrs) %>% pull(P.Value),
  demographic_schlyrs.estimate = demographic_schlyrs %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_schlyrs) %>% pull(logFC),
  demographic_schlyrs.pval = demographic_schlyrs %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_schlyrs) %>% pull(P.Value),
  h_schlyrs.estimate = h_schlyrs %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_schlyrs) %>% pull(logFC),
  h_schlyrs.pval = h_schlyrs %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_schlyrs) %>% pull(P.Value)
)

overlap_schlyrs$gene <- gsub(";.*", "", overlap_schlyrs$gene)
write_xlsx(overlap_schlyrs, "Manuscript/Revisions/Compare_Models/ALL SCHLYRS Models CpG Overlap.xlsx", format_headers = TRUE)



#LIVEGPAR OVERLAP
overlap_livegpar <- Reduce(intersect, list(livegpar_m3$CpG, demographic_livegpar$CpG, h_livegpar$CpG))

overlap_livegpar <- data.frame(
  CpG = overlap_livegpar,
  chr = livegpar_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_livegpar) %>% pull(CHR),
  pos = livegpar_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_livegpar) %>% pull(BP),
  gene = livegpar_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_livegpar) %>% pull(UCSC_RefGene_Name),

  h_livegpar.estimate = h_livegpar %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_livegpar) %>% pull(logFC),

)

overlap_livegpar$gene <- gsub(";.*", "", overlap_livegpar$gene)
write_xlsx(overlap_livegpar, "Manuscript/Revisions/Compare_Models/ALL LIVEGPAR Models CpG Overlap.xlsx", format_headers = TRUE)


#CHILD SMOKING OVERLAP
overlap_chsmk <- Reduce(intersect, list(demographic_chsmk$CpG, demographic_chsmk$CpG, h_chsmk$CpG))
overlap_chsmk <- Reduce(intersect, list(chsmk_m3$CpG, demographic_chsmk$CpG, h_chsmk$CpG))

overlap_chsmk <- data.frame(
  CpG = overlap_chsmk,
  chr = chsmk_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_chsmk) %>% pull(CHR),
  pos = chsmk_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_chsmk) %>% pull(BP),
  gene = chsmk_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_chsmk) %>% pull(UCSC_RefGene_Name),
  chsmk_m3.estimate = chsmk_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_chsmk) %>% pull(logFC),
  chsmk_m3.pval = chsmk_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_chsmk) %>% pull(P.Value),
  demographic_chsmk.estimate = demographic_chsmk %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_chsmk) %>% pull(logFC),
  demographic_chsmk.pval = demographic_chsmk %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_chsmk) %>% pull(P.Value),
  h_chsmk.estimate = h_chsmk %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_chsmk) %>% pull(logFC),
  h_chsmk.pval = h_chsmk %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_chsmk) %>% pull(P.Value)
)

overlap_chsmk$gene <- gsub(";.*", "", overlap_chsmk$gene)
write_xlsx(overlap_chsmk, "Manuscript/Revisions/Compare_Models/ALL CHILD SMK Models CpG Overlap.xlsx", format_headers = TRUE)

```

## COMPARE SITES WITH PRIOR LITERATURE

### Years in School

```{r, warning=FALSE}
#SCHLYRS OVERLAP
overlap_schlyrs_maternalea <- Reduce(intersect, list(maternal_educ_ewas$CpG, demographic_schlyrs$CpG))
overlap_schlyrs2 <- data.frame(
  CpG = overlap_schlyrs_maternalea,
  chr = demographic_schlyrs %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_schlyrs_maternalea) %>% pull(CHR),
  pos = demographic_schlyrs %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_schlyrs_maternalea) %>% pull(BP),
  gene = demographic_schlyrs %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_schlyrs_maternalea) %>% pull(UCSC_RefGene_Name),
  demographic_schlyrs.estimate = demographic_schlyrs %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_schlyrs_maternalea) %>% pull(logFC),
  demographic_schlyrs.pval = demographic_schlyrs %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_schlyrs_maternalea) %>% pull(P.Value),
  maternal_educ_ewas.estimate = maternal_educ_ewas %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_schlyrs_maternalea) %>% pull(logFC),
  maternal_educ_ewas.pval = maternal_educ_ewas %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_schlyrs_maternalea) %>% pull(P.Value)
)
overlap_schlyrs2$gene <- gsub(";.*", "", overlap_schlyrs2$gene)

# Get top shared significant site (p< 0.0001)
sig_hitss2 <- overlap_schlyrs2 %>%  filter(maternal_educ_ewas.pval < 0.0001 & demographic_schlyrs.pval < 0.0001)

sheets = list('All Overlap' = overlap_schlyrs2, 'P<0.0001' = sig_hitss2)
writexl::write_xlsx(sheets, 'Manuscript/Revisions/Compare_Models/Demographic Years in School Overlap p<0.0001 maternal ea.xlsx', format_headers = TRUE)

```
